title: Read it back later
note: The moon breathes over "Writing down what you said." and the recording's length. After 8 seconds one line says long recordings take a little more time; after 15 seconds with no progress a quiet "Read it back later" appears (S14). The web build records with the browser's fake microphone (a steady tone) and has no speech model, so the words never arrive; the real app writes them down on the phone.
